data.sections.decal.image.description: Takes a single image for the decal - NOT TO BE CONFUSED WITH IMAGE STACK
data.sections.decal.layer.description: Sets the layer of the decal, values from lowest to highest - shadow, beforeBody, afterBody, onTop, beforeUI, inactive
data.sections.decal.order.description: Defaults as 0, sets a more discrete layering if 2 or more decals takes same layer type. Otherwise order in INI file will be used.
data.sections.decal.teamColors.descripti: When true, automatically reassigns team color to respective teams
data.sections.decal.alpha.description: 0-1, sets transparency of decal (images or line)
data.sections.decal.isVisible.descriptio: Dynamic Value, draws the decal on a specific condition
data.sections.decal.onlyWhenSelectedByOw: Only When Selected By Own Player
Defaults as false, displays the decal only if the owner player clicks on the unit
data.sections.decal.onlyWhenSelectedByEn: Only When Selected By Enemy Player
Defaults as false, displays the decal only if the enemy player clicks on the unit
data.sections.decal.onlyWhenSelectedByAl: Only When Selected By Ally Not Own Player
Defaults as false, displays the decal only if the allied player clicks on the unit
data.sections.decal.onlyWhenSelectedByAn: Only When Selected By Any Player
Defaults as false, displays the decal only if any player clicks on the unit
data.sections.decal.includeParentsSelect: Useable with onlyWhenSelectedBy[insertplayer], will also checks parent's selection when true. Useful with attachments.
data.sections.decal.onlyTeam.description: Draws the decal if value matches the player from the following: own, notOwn, ally, allyNotOwn, enemy, any
data.sections.decal.onlyWhileActive.desc: Draws the decal only if the unit is fully built
data.sections.decal.onlyWhileAlive.descr: Draws the decal only if the unit is alive (If beforeUI layer default true, else default false)
data.sections.decal.onlyInPreview.descri: Only show in sidebar, and building placement preview
data.sections.decal.onlyWithZoomLevelOrM: Only With Zoom Level Or More
Draws the decal only if the zoom level matches or exceeds it, very useful for making 3D units more optimized.
data.sections.decal.onlyOnNonPreview.des: Draws the decal only on the unit itself, not on the preview from building or in sidebar interface
data.sections.decal.onlyPlayersWithUnitC: Draws the decal if a player that selects it has control (that includes shared units in multiplayer)
data.sections.decal.onlyOnBodyFrameOf.de: Only draw decal when body frame is equal to this
data.sections.decal.xOffsetRelative.desc: Sets horizontal offset relative to the unit
data.sections.decal.yOffsetRelative.desc: Sets vertical offset relative to the unit
data.sections.decal.hOffset.description: Sets the height of the whole decal
data.sections.decal.dirOffset.descriptio: Sets the direction of the whole decal.
data.sections.decal.pivotOffset.descript: only affects relative offsets without rotating image
data.sections.decal.alwaysStartDirAtZero: Keeps the decal on north direction regardless of the unit's direction value, useful for custom in-unit interfaces
data.sections.decal.imageStack.descripti: Takes one or more image with occassional multipliers for stacking. Also useful for using image stack from a MagicaVoxel slice export
data.sections.decal.stack_hOffset.descri: Sets the height of every layer in a stack. 1 layer = 1 pixel. Can take negative values.
data.sections.decal.stack_frameOffset.de: Useful for making 3D units, frame to offset by in imageStack. Often a value of 1 is useful in a sprite sheet.
data.sections.decal.stack_drawInReverseO: Renders the stack in the opposite way - last frame goes on bottom, first frame goes to top
data.sections.decal.stack_indexStart.des: Offset to start drawing images in the image stack
data.sections.decal.stack_indexCount.des: Number of images in the image stack to draw.
data.sections.decal.total_frames.descrip: Sets the number of frames in an image from an imageStack that uses a spritesheet.
data.sections.decal.frame_width.descript: Sets the frame width in the decal stack
data.sections.decal.frame_height.descrip: Sets the frame height in the decal stack
data.sections.decal.addBodyFrameMultipli: Add body frame number to this decal when set to 1.
data.sections.decal.image_shadow.descrip: Sets shadow for the decal. Note that AUTO does not work in this key.
data.sections.decal.shadowOffsetX.descri: Sets the horizontal position of the decal's shadow
data.sections.decal.shadowOffsetY.descri: Sets the vertical position of the decal's shadow
data.sections.decal.basePosition.descrip: Attaches the decal on the specified marker. use "self" if attaching it to the unit itself
data.sections.decal.basePositionFromLegE: Attaches the decal to the specified leg or arm ending.
data.sections.decal.basePositionFromTurr: Attaches the decal to the specified turret
data.sections.decal.drawLineTo.descripti: Draws a line from the unit to the specified marker, useful for custom waypoints
data.sections.decal.color.description: Sets the color of the drawn line
data.sections.decal.lineWidth.descriptio: Sets the width of the drawn line
